defect: The certifier always passed --test-reporter=tap to its freeze-test subprocess. Under scripts/reproducibility/run-canonical.mjs, NODE_OPTIONS already carries --test-reporter=tap, so node --test aborted with ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE (two reporters, no destinations). The first two read-only --check runs therefore recomputed TESTS_PASS=false and reported CERTIFICATION_REPRODUCED=false, although the freeze rebuilt byte-identically and the tests pass.
correction: Add --test-reporter=tap only when NODE_OPTIONS does not already set a reporter (the rule the Stage 3G.6/3G.7 suite runners already use).
